scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.train:ai: uv run --directory ai-service --with huggingface-hub --with python-dotenv python train_lora.py --epochs 3 --batch-size 2 --push-to-hub
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run --prefix backend build && npm run --prefix frontend build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
